name: capture-learning-tools
title: Capture learning
description: Turn technical conversations, bugs, CI failures, and repeated agent mistakes into durable project improvements: shared agent instructions, tests, CI, scripts, docs, ADRs, or explicit no-automation decisions.
notes:
## What it does

Engineering Learning Loop is a portable prevention skill. It reads a conversation or incident, inspects the repository, explains the issue in plain English, and recommends where the learning should live in the project.

## Design principles

- The project is the source of truth.
- Propose before editing.
- Prefer tests, scripts, and CI over prose when machine-checkable.
- Keep shared instructions in one source with host-specific adapters.
- Account for private CI cost, public open-source CI expectations, and non-technical users.

## Bundled helpers

The package includes dependency-free Python scripts for inspecting project guidance files, summarizing CI surface, and classifying learnings into likely destinations.
